pre_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Automator" to quit' && sleep 2 && rm -f ~/Desktop/Compiled_Report.pdf && mkdir -p ~/Documents/Reports && [ -f ~/Documents/Reports/report1.txt ] || echo "Sample report 1 content" > ~/Documents/Reports/report1.txt && [ -f ~/Documents/Reports/report2.txt ] || echo "Sample report 2 content" > ~/Documents/Reports/report2.txt
instruction: Create a workflow to compile a PDF from all text files located in 'Documents/Reports' and save the final document as 'Compiled_Report.pdf' on the Desktop.
evaluator: [ -s ~/Desktop/Compiled_Report.pdf ] && if command -v pdftotext >/dev/null 2>&1; then pdftotext ~/Desktop/Compiled_Report.pdf /tmp/pdf_content.txt 2>/dev/null && [ -s /tmp/pdf_content.txt ] && grep -q "Sample report 1 content" /tmp/pdf_content.txt && grep -q "Sample report 2 content" /tmp/pdf_content.txt && rm -f /tmp/pdf_content.txt && echo True || (rm -f /tmp/pdf_content.txt; echo False); else python3 -c "import PyPDF2, os; pdf_path = os.path.expanduser('~/Desktop/Compiled_Report.pdf'); try: with open(pdf_path, 'rb') as f: reader = PyPDF2.PdfReader(f); text = ''.join([page.extract_text() for page in reader.pages]); print('True' if 'Sample report 1 content' in text and 'Sample report 2 content' in text else 'False'); except: print('False')" 2>/dev/null || echo False; fi
